name: QQQ SMA-12-month momentum regime filter (adapted from SPY template, GT-52 gap fill)

source.repo_or_note: adapted from SPY sma12_monthly_momentum template (2026-08-15, GT-52 validation-gap fill)

hypothesis: The SPY 12-month SMA regime filter transfers to QQQ: holding QQQ only while above its 12-month SMA beats buy-and-hold on risk-adjusted monthly returns.

rules.entry: Long when price closes above the 12-month SMA at the monthly bar.
rules.exit: Flat when price closes below the 12-month SMA.
rules.position_sizing: All-in/out monthly in the scan model.
rules.risk_limits: None in scan model; JARVIS gates apply.
rules.fees_and_slippage_model: Gross in scan; monthly turnover implies minimal cost drag.

known_failure_modes: DSR 0.0 — the adapted template's edge does not survive trial-count correction on QQQ
Monthly regime filter does NOT validate the live 1h options-scanner pipeline that generates QQQ's paper fills (card note)
